   12  from __future__ import annotations
   13  
   14  import hashlib
   15  import hmac
   16  import io
   17  import tarfile
   18  import urllib.request
   19  from dataclasses import dataclass, field
   20  from typing import Annotated
   21  from pathlib import Path
   22  
   23  from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Header, HTTPException, status
   24  from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
   25  
   26  UPLOAD_ROOT = Path("/var/files-lite/uploads")
   27  STAGING_ROOT = Path("/var/files-lite/staging")
   28  ALLOWED_FETCH_HOSTS = frozenset({"assets.example.test", "cdn.example.test"})
   29  
   30  
   31  @dataclass
   32  class User:
   33      id: str
   34      name: str
   35  
   36

   55      s = Store()
   56      s.users = {"usr_alice": User("usr_alice", "Alice Example"), "usr_bob": User("usr_bob", "Bob Example")}

   58      s.documents = {
   59          "doc_a1": Document("doc_a1", "usr_alice", "quarterly-report.txt", "shr_tok_a1", b"report"),
   60          "doc_b1": Document("doc_b1", "usr_bob", "notes.txt", "shr_tok_b1", b"notes"),

  102          root = UPLOAD_ROOT.resolve()
